display_name: LoRa W24 首尾联合损失双路线正式盲测
description: Test the source-qualified frozen outer-chirp restorer on the registered 30,000-packet Full and native Residual matrix.
authorization: Active LoRa and WiSig restoration research goal authorizes isolated component diagnostics.

code.commit: Committed evaluator verified when the source candidate is eligible for publication
code.environment: N607 archived W24 runtime Python and independent local CPU truth-last scorer
code.cwd: original frozen W24 reader release for prediction

data.version: Registered W24 15 unseen receiver native test matrix
data.representation: 8 chirps, 384 complex center samples + 48 native edge samples
data.contract_ref: Identical native_target_root and source_root as immutable 20261125-phase1-lora-w24-formal-ungated-s2026092702-r01
data.physical_ids_ref: The archived native receive cache physical order; 2000 packets in each of 15 receivers
data.validation_ref: Exact per-packet fresh direct parity against the blind archive for every tested view

permissions.claim_scope: Independent formal target evaluation conditional on the registered source qualification. Frozen checkpoint and rule. Only the independent local scorer reads official target TX labels.

checkpoint.initialization: Immutable source-qualified final recovery weights; no fit during this run

sources.role: Conditionally admitted trained recovery weight, terminal step 40000

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: w24_formal.qualified_outer, blind_reference, and load_candidate calls before target predictor
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Training owner only used source U IQ. Comparators bound by the exact archive code and cache paths plus direct decision parity. Frozen F and no-input-threshold G.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Use the already preregistered dual-route source checks in the source owner record. No target feedback; no alternate epoch.

execution.gpu_policy: At most two case workers, each on one eligible card plus eight CPU channel workers. Preserve current healthy workloads.
execution.stop_rule: Do not launch until source qualification passes. Stop downstream for missing archive, invalid checkpoint, no-target smoke, direct mismatch, incomplete all-packet coverage or incomplete blind shards.

rows.method: Frozen W24 E104 plus outer-objective W24 DURA, fixed half correction for every packet

data_overrides.cohort: 15 unseen receivers, Full and native Residual, clean and six practical scenes

rows.seed_notes: Candidate and reader are fixed. Recreate target observations under registered physical row keys and fixed namespace; reuse all row order and partitioning. No support.
rows.budget_ref: 30000 blind physical packets each on both routes; each clean and six practical scenes runs G

notes: This run has not launched and may proceed only after existing source-only qualification.
Acceptance retains 156600/180000 and 24000/30000 Full thresholds, paired baseline comparisons and clean maintenance.
